text: NightDragon Management Company, LLC's SEC Form ADV Schedule A (direct owners and executive officers) lists David DeWalt as a managing member and control person with ownership code D, which the form's legend defines as "50% but less than 75%", since September 2019.
short: David DeWalt owns 50–75% of NightDragon and controls it (SEC Form ADV)

source.name: U.S. SEC Investment Adviser Public Disclosure: Form ADV, NightDragon Management Company, LLC (CRD 310767)
source.quote: DEWALT, DAVID I MANAGING MEMBER 09/2019 D Y N
source.note: Schedule A of the firm's annual amendment Form ADV, generated 2026-03-27; the same legend that defines code D as '50% but less than 75%' appears directly above the table. The filing also lists Kenneth Gonzalez as a managing member with ownership code NA (less than 5%).
